senses.gloss: small snack served on bread in a bar
senses.example: Tomamos pinchos en la calle Estafeta.
senses.exampleGloss: We have pinchos on Calle Estafeta.

alternatives.reason: How menus spell it in Pamplona and Navarre; same food, local flavour.
Spain-wide word for a small bar portion, traditionally included with a drink.
A plate-sized portion, not a single pincho.

notes: Navarre-specific culture word; the example uses the real Calle Estafeta in Pamplona.
